text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By continually trying to get used to being 
the lead, Transcend gradually grew 
comfortable with being in the spotlight. 
With this, she should be able to run 
proudly in her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, things must be taken step by 
step, and rushing into battling strong 
opponents should be avoided. The Trainer 
proposes a race with fewer rivals for her 
next outing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Transcend and the Trainer set their next 
goal on the Leopard Stakes, playing it 
safe with fewer strong opponents.
